The laptop

items.common_wrong_reason_bn: বেশি connector মানেই বেশি cohesion ভাবা।

items.question_en: Which paragraph opening is mechanically repetitive?
items.question_bn: কোন paragraph opening mechanically repetitive?
items.context_en: Each sentence presents one step in the same short process.
items.context_bn: প্রতিটি sentence একই ছোট process-এর একটি step।

options.text: Firstly, the form is checked. Secondly, the form is copied. Thirdly, the form is filed. Fourthly, the form is stored.
The form is checked, copied, filed and then stored.
After checking the form, staff copy and file it before storage.
Staff check the form; they then copy, file and store it.

items.correct_answer: Firstly, the form is checked. Secondly, the form is copied. Thirdly, the form is filed. Fourthly, the form is stored.
items.explanation_en: A mechanically repeats a numbered connector for every trivial step; the alternatives group the process clearly.
items.explanation_bn: A প্রতিটি ছোট step-এ mechanically numbered connector repeat করে।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Formal marker থাকলেই style ভালো ভাবা।

items.question_en: Which order correctly describes the stated emergency procedure?
items.question_bn: Emergency procedure-এর সঠিক order কোনটি?
items.context_en: The posted procedure says: sound the alarm, leave by the nearest exit, then gather at the assembly point.
items.context_bn: Notice-এ বলা: alarm, exit, assembly point।

options.text: Alarm → exit → assembly point
Assembly point → alarm → exit
Exit → assembly point → alarm
Assembly point → exit → alarm

items.correct_answer: Alarm → exit → assembly point
items.explanation_en: A exactly follows the posted procedure.
items.explanation_bn: A notice-এর stated order ঠিক অনুসরণ করে।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: নিজের routine ধরে stated process বদলানো।

items.question_en: Which phrase has a clear antecedent?
items.question_bn: কোন phrase-এর antecedent পরিষ্কার?
items.context_en: The council rejected the proposal. ___ disappointed the applicants.
items.context_bn: Council proposal reject করে; rejection applicants-কে disappointed করে।

options.text: This decision
They
It and they
Those people

items.correct_answer: This decision
items.explanation_en: This decision clearly refers to the rejection.
items.explanation_bn: This decision স্পষ্টভাবে rejection-কে refer করে।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Vague pronoun নেওয়া।

items.question_en: Choose the non-repetitive sentence.
items.question_bn: Repetition ছাড়া sentence বেছে নিন।
items.context_en: The aim is to state one fact once.
items.context_bn: একটি fact একবার বলতে হবে।

options.text: The final outcome was completely final.
The outcome was final.
The final result was the ultimate outcome in the end.
In the final analysis, the final outcome remained final.

items.correct_answer: The outcome was final.
items.explanation_en: B states the idea once without redundant wording.
items.explanation_bn: B redundant wording ছাড়া idea একবার বলে।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Grammatical repetition-কে emphasis ভাবা।

items.question_en: Which sentence best concludes the paragraph?
items.question_bn: কোন sentence paragraph-টি best conclude করে?
items.context_en: The paragraph shows that home insulation lowers energy use and winter bills.
items.context_bn: Paragraph insulation energy use ও winter bill কমায় দেখায়।

options.text: Thus, insulation can benefit both household budgets and energy conservation.
By contrast, summer electricity demand may rise during heatwaves.
For example, some houses have wooden doors and tiled roofs.
Nevertheless, utility companies use several billing formats.

items.correct_answer: Thus, insulation can benefit both household budgets and energy conservation.
items.explanation_en: A alone synthesises both established benefits without shifting focus.
items.explanation_bn: শুধু A focus না বদলে established দুই benefit synthesize করে।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Conclusion-এ related-sounding কিন্তু নতুন idea আনা।

items.question_en: Which connector marks a direct comparison of differences?
items.question_bn: Difference compare করতে কোন connector?
items.context_en: City A expanded rail services. ___, City B invested mainly in buses.
items.context_bn: City A rail, City B bus-এ invest করে।

options.text: By contrast
As a result
For example
In addition

items.correct_answer: By contrast
items.explanation_en: By contrast explicitly compares the different strategies.
items.explanation_bn: By contrast দুই ভিন্ন strategy compare করে।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Addition connector নেওয়া।

items.question_en: Which revision creates a clear topic-to-example link?
items.question_bn: কোন revision topic থেকে example-এ clear link তৈরি করে?
items.context_en: Community gardens can strengthen neighbourhood ties. Residents at one garden organise a shared meal each month.
items.context_bn: Community garden tie বাড়ায়; একটি garden-এ monthly meal হয়।

options.text: For example, residents at one garden organise a shared meal each month.
Therefore, residents at one garden organise a shared meal each month.
However, residents at one garden organise a shared meal each month.
In contrast, residents at one garden organise a shared meal each month.

items.correct_answer: For example, residents at one garden organise a shared meal each month.
items.explanation_en: A correctly frames the specific case as evidence for the general claim; the other connectors misstate the relationship.
items.explanation_bn: A specific case-কে general claim-এর example করে; অন্য connector relation বদলায়।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Semantic relation না দেখে grammatical connector বসানো।

items.question_en: Which revision uniquely identifies what was delayed?
items.question_bn: কোন revision delayed বিষয়টি uniquely চিহ্নিত করে?
items.context_en: The committee sent the report to the agency after the agency delayed the report's publication.
items.context_bn: Agency report publication delay করে; committee report পাঠায়।

options.text: After the agency delayed publication of the report, the committee sent the report to the agency.
After it delayed it, they sent it to them.
After the committee delayed the agency, the report sent it.
After its delay, it was sent there by them.

items.correct_answer: After the agency delayed publication of the report, the committee sent the report to the agency.
items.explanation_en: A names the actor, action and affected publication without vague pronouns.
items.explanation_bn: A actor, action ও publication স্পষ্ট করে।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Multiple it/them reference clear ধরে নেওয়া।

items.question_en: Which revision removes redundancy without creating a new error?
items.question_bn: কোন revision নতুন error ছাড়া redundancy সরায়?
items.context_en: The two alternatives are both equally acceptable.
items.context_bn: দুটি alternative equally acceptable।

options.text: The two alternatives are equally acceptable.
The two alternatives are both equally acceptable alternatives.
The alternative are equal acceptably.
Both two alternatives are equally both acceptable.

items.correct_answer: The two alternatives are equally acceptable.
items.explanation_en: A removes redundant both while preserving the meaning and grammar.
items.explanation_bn: A redundant both সরিয়ে meaning ও grammar রাখে।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Redundancy repair করতে গিয়ে grammar ভাঙা।

items.question_en: Which revision retains all three facts and improves cohesion?
items.question_bn: কোন revision তিনটি fact রেখে cohesion উন্নত করে?
items.context_en: The museum extended its hours. Visitor numbers rose. Staffing costs also increased.
items.context_bn: Museum hour বাড়ায়; visitor বাড়ে; staffing cost-ও বাড়ে।

options.text: After the museum extended its hours, visitor numbers rose, but staffing costs also increased.
The museum extended its hours, so visitor numbers rose without any increase in staffing costs.
Visitor numbers rose because staffing costs replaced the museum's hours.
The museum extended its hours and visitor numbers rose.

items.correct_answer: After the museum extended its hours, visitor numbers rose, but staffing costs also increased.
items.explanation_en: Only A retains the extension, visitor increase and cost increase while signalling the trade-off.
items.explanation_bn: শুধু A তিন fact রেখে trade-off দেখায়।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Fluent sentence নিতে গিয়ে একটি fact বাদ দেওয়া।

items.question_en: Which sentence weakens coherence by shifting the controlling focus?
items.question_bn: কোন sentence controlling focus বদলে coherence দুর্বল করে?
items.context_en: Focus: whether later school start times improve adolescent sleep.
items.context_bn: Focus: school দেরিতে শুরু হলে adolescent sleep উন্নত হয় কি না।

options.text: Several trials reported longer sleep after start times moved later.
Adolescents often experience shifts in sleep timing.
School uniforms vary widely in colour and price.
Travel schedules may affect how much extra sleep students gain.

items.correct_answer: School uniforms vary widely in colour and price.
items.explanation_en: C changes the focus from sleep and start times to uniforms.
items.explanation_bn: C sleep/start time থেকে uniform-এ focus বদলায়।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: School topic মিলকে relevance ভাবা।

items.question_en: Which connector best marks the surprising outcome despite the warning?
items.question_bn: Warning সত্ত্বেও surprising outcome বোঝাতে কোন connector best?
items.context_en: Experts warned that demand would fall. ___, sales reached a record high.
items.context_bn: Demand কমার warning ছিল; তবু sales record high হয়।

options.text: Nevertheless
For example
Consequently
Similarly

items.correct_answer: Nevertheless
items.explanation_en: Nevertheless marks an outcome that occurs despite the warning.
items.explanation_bn: Nevertheless warning সত্ত্বেও বিপরীত outcome দেখায়।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Simple comparison marker দিয়ে concession বোঝানো।

items.question_en: Which revision uses cohesion without repeating the same connector?
items.question_bn: একই connector repeat না করে কোন revision cohesion রাখে?
items.context_en: Furthermore, the course is affordable. Furthermore, it is flexible. Furthermore, it is widely available.
items.context_bn: একই addition connector তিনবার repeat হয়েছে।

options.text: The course is affordable, flexible and widely available.
Furthermore, furthermore, the course is affordable, flexible and available.
However, the course is affordable because flexibility contrasts availability.
The course is affordable; nevertheless, it is flexible and therefore unavailable.

items.correct_answer: The course is affordable, flexible and widely available.
items.explanation_en: A groups parallel qualities without mechanical connector repetition.
items.explanation_bn: A mechanical connector repetition ছাড়া parallel quality group করে।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: প্রতি sentence-এ connector আবশ্যক ভাবা।

items.question_en: Which revision preserves all information and improves flow without overpacking?
items.question_bn: কোন revision সব information রেখে flow উন্নত করে, overpack নয়?
items.context_en: The pilot reduced waiting times. It served only one clinic. A larger trial is therefore needed before nationwide adoption.
items.context_bn: Pilot waiting time কমায়; এক clinic-এ ছিল; nationwide adoption-এর আগে larger trial দরকার।

options.text: Although the pilot reduced waiting times, it served only one clinic; therefore, a larger trial is needed before nationwide adoption.
The successful pilot proves nationwide adoption is necessary immediately.
The pilot served one clinic, so it did not reduce waiting times.
Although the pilot, which reduced waiting times and served one clinic and was national, therefore adoption.

items.correct_answer: Although the pilot reduced waiting times, it served only one clinic; therefore, a larger trial is needed before nationwide adoption.
items.explanation_en: A retains the benefit, limitation and cautious next step with explicit relationships.
items.explanation_bn: A benefit, limitation ও cautious next step—সব relation স্পষ্ট রেখে দেয়।
items.common_wrong_reason_bn: Flow improve করতে গিয়ে limitation বা caution বাদ দেওয়া।
